# DCSI, Inc. — "Security & Sound"

> DCSI, Inc. is a full-service security and sound company in Lutz, Florida, serving
> Hillsborough and Pasco Counties in the Tampa Bay area, with alarm monitoring and
> scheduled installation across Central Florida from Venice north to Ocala. Founded
> in 2004, DCSI designs, installs, and monitors residential and commercial alarm
> systems, CCTV camera systems, gate and access control, home theater and
> whole-home audio, and structured wiring. Alarm monitoring is handled in house
> rather than outsourced to a third-party call center.

## Key facts

- Legal name: DCSI, Inc.
- Also known as: DCS, DCS Security, DCS Alarm, DCSI Security. "DCS" is a common
  short form of the name. DCSI, Inc. of Lutz, FL is not affiliated with other
  companies or products that use the initials DCS.
- Address: 128 W. Lutz Lake Fern Rd, Lutz, FL 33548, United States (one office)
- Phone: (813) 949-6500
- Fax: (813) 949-6599
- Email: info@dcsisecurity.com
- Founded: 2004
- Service area: Hillsborough and Pasco Counties are the core market; the Lutz
  office sits on the county line. Monitoring and scheduled installation extend to
  Pinellas, Hernando, Polk, Manatee, Sarasota, and Marion Counties.
- Monitoring: 24/7, in house, from the Lutz office. Cellular communicators as
  standard. No long-term monitoring contract required.
- Takeovers: existing industry-standard alarm panels can usually be moved to DCSI
  monitoring without replacing sensors or wiring.
- Consultations and quotes: free, no obligation
- Warranty: 90 days on labor, 1 year on parts; extended warranties and service
  contracts available

## Services

- [Security systems & 24/7 monitoring](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/security-monitoring):
  Custom residential and commercial burglar alarm systems, silent alarms, medical
  and panic alerts, fire systems, home automation, and in-house 24/7 monitoring.
- [Alarm monitoring takeover](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/alarm-monitoring-takeover):
  Switching an existing alarm system to DCSI monitoring — panel reprogramming,
  landline/3G to LTE cellular communicator upgrades, no long-term contract.
- [Commercial security](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/commercial-security):
  Business alarms with per-employee codes and open/close reporting, commercial
  cameras, access control, and environmental (cooler, water, power) monitoring.
- [Access control & gates](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/access-control):
  Fob, card, keypad, and mobile-credential access for doors and gates, gate
  operators, telephone-entry and video intercoms, schedules, and audit logs.
- [CCTV camera systems](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/camera-systems):
  IP camera and NVR installation, indoor and outdoor cameras, remote mobile viewing, event
  and continuous recording, and video verification of alarm events.
- [HOA & CDD community security](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/hoa-cdd):
  Gate and entry access control, common area and amenity cameras, perimeter
  monitoring, video intercom and visitor management, and community-wide contracts.
- [New construction low voltage pre-wire](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/new-construction):
  Security and camera rough-in, CAT6 structured wiring, home theater pre-wire,
  access control pre-wire, and central vacuum for builders and developers.
- [Home theater & AV](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/home-theater):
  Projector and screen systems, TV mounting and media walls, surround sound and
  Atmos, in-wall wiring, calibration, equipment racks, and commercial AV.
- [Whole-home & outdoor audio](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/whole-home-audio):
  In-ceiling and in-wall speakers, lanai and pool-deck outdoor audio, independent
  zone control, streaming and voice control, and commercial distributed audio.
- [Structured wiring & smart home](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/structured-wiring):
  CAT6 data cabling to a central panel, whole-home Wi-Fi design, smart locks and
  video doorbells, thermostats and lighting, and central vacuum.

## Resources

- [All guides](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources)
- [Security system cost guide](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/security-system-cost):
  What drives the price of a security system and alarm monitoring in Tampa Bay,
  and the contract terms that cost buyers the most.
- [Wired vs. wireless alarm systems](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/wired-vs-wireless-alarm-systems):
  Why Florida concrete block construction favors wireless retrofits, and when
  hardwired or hybrid systems are the better choice.
- [DIY vs. professional security systems](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/diy-vs-professional-security):
  Self-install kits vs. professionally installed alarm systems: design, existing
  wiring, monitoring, cameras, and which homes each one suits.
- [Choosing a monitoring company](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/choosing-a-monitoring-company):
  In-house vs. wholesale monitoring, contract terms, equipment ownership,
  communication path, response procedure, and licensing.
- [Landline & 3G alarm upgrade](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/landline-alarm-upgrade):
  How to tell if an alarm panel still reaches its monitoring center after copper
  retirement and the 2022 3G shutdown, and how to upgrade to cellular.
- [False alarm prevention](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/false-alarm-prevention):
  Common causes of false alarms and fixes, and Florida's alarm confirmation
  requirement before police dispatch (section 489.529, Florida Statutes).
- [Switching alarm companies](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/switching-alarm-companies):
  Changing monitoring companies without replacing the system: contract term,
  renewal and cancellation clauses, equipment ownership, locked panels, cutover.
- [Medical alert through an alarm system](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/medical-alert-alarm-systems):
  Medical pendants, wall buttons, two-way voice, medical call lists, range
  limits, and questions to ask before buying.
- [Hurricane season security checklist](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/hurricane-season-security):
  Keeping alarms and cameras working through power outages, evacuation,
  shutters, and the week after a storm.
- [Snowbird & vacant home security](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/vacant-home-security):
  Water, temperature, and power-loss monitoring, keyholder call lists, and a
  pre-departure checklist for seasonally empty Florida homes.
- [How many security cameras a house needs](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/how-many-security-cameras):
  Counting cameras by approach, typical counts by property type, PoE vs. Wi-Fi,
  resolution, and footage retention.
- [Security camera footage retention](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/security-camera-footage-retention):
  Estimating NVR storage from bitrate (1 Mbps ≈ 10.8 GB/day), worked examples,
  continuous vs. motion recording, and how many days to keep.
- [HOA & CDD board guide](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/hoa-board-security-guide):
  How association and district boards should scope, budget, and procure community
  gate access and camera projects.
- [Builder pre-wire guide](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/builder-prewire-guide):
  When to schedule low voltage rough-in, base package scope, buyer upgrades, and
  coordination practices that reduce warranty callbacks.
- [Burglar alarm FAQ](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/burglar-alarm-faq):
  How alarm systems work, what happens when one is triggered, what 24/7 monitoring
  covers, remote control, residential vs. commercial systems, Florida alarm
  permits, and power-outage behavior.
- [Pet-friendly alarm systems](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/pet-friendly-alarm-systems):
  Pet-immune motion detector weight ratings, placement, climbing pets, and
  perimeter-first layouts that prevent pet false alarms.
- [Home security safety tips](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/safety-tips):
  Eight practical steps homeowners can take to reduce burglary risk.
- [Burglary statistics](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/burglary-statistics):
  National and Florida property crime figures, each attributed to its source
  (FBI UCR, DOJ, UNC Charlotte study).
